neighbours.label: relief from a burden: a load or strain taken off someone (lifted from, take the strain off, rid them of)
fire: When the exam was finally over, a huge weight was lifted from my shoulders.
Hiring an assistant took some of the pressure off the head chef.
The new bypass will relieve congestion in the town centre.
The settlement freed the family of a debt they had carried for years.
Offloading the heavy computation to a server saves the phone's battery.
The grant rid the small farm of the cost of disposing of its waste.
Volunteers came in to ease the burden on the exhausted nurses.
Selling the second house relieved them of the monthly mortgage payments.
quiet: When the exam was finally over, I went straight to the cinema with my friends.
Hiring an assistant gave the head chef someone to talk to.
The new bypass will run along the river past the town centre.
The settlement gave the family a house they had wanted for years.
Running the heavy computation on the phone drains its battery.
The grant paid the small farm to plant a row of trees along its fields.
Volunteers came in to sing songs for the exhausted nurses.
Selling the second house gave them a little money to travel.
